newsitem.title: USA: Synthetic sees Q2 oper shr $0.21-$0.24.
newsitem.headline: Synthetic sees Q2 oper shr $0.21-$0.24.

text.p: Synthetic Industries Inc said Thursday it expects to report operating income of $0.21 to $0.24 a share, or $1.9 million to $2.2 million, for the fiscal second quarter ended March 31.
The polypropylene fabrics and fibers manufacturer, which went public in November, said projection is before an extraordinary loss arising from early retirement of debt.

The extraordinary loss will amount to about $12 million, or $1.33 per share, and results from the repurchase of 12-3/4 percent senior subordinated debentures and the paydown of bank loans, the company said.
For the comparable quarter in its fiscal 1996, the company reported a loss of $400,000, or $0.07 per share.
Synthetic said there were about 50 percent more weighted average shares outstanding in its latest quarter than a year earlier, due to its initial public offering last November.
The company said it expects second quarter revenues to reach $75 million, compared with $65 million a year ago.
It said earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization are expected to be about 18 percent of sales, compared to 14.8 percent a year ago.
